instructions_to_main_agent: Target JavaScript files (.js/.jsx) for all React components in frontend/src/.
Replace existing dark-theme gate views with this warm light ivory (#FAF8F5) + navy (#0F1E33) + gold (#C9A24A) theme.
Implement GeoBranchGate.jsx and SalonSwitcher.jsx using these exact tokens and rounded-2xl / rounded-3xl radii.
Ensure every interactive element (buttons, inputs, cards, retry links, sign out links) includes data-testid attributes (kebab-case).
Maintain auto-pick logic when exactly 1 branch matches GPS (<100m).
Show faint map background for the nearest branch card.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Never use dark backgrounds for full screen unless explicitly requested for luxury night mode.
Avoid default system buttons; use custom rounded buttons with warm gold gradients.
All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes.
